script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not say whether Abraham rushed past his grief or acted as if he were fine.
Isaac being Abraham's son is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not say Abraham owned no ground or that his status was why he had to ask.
The text does not say how recently Sarah died, so 'just died' adds a time detail.
The passage does not say Abraham haggled. He asks to pay full price and pays the price Ephron names.
Saying Abraham thanked them with a bow assigns a meaning to his action that the text does not give.
The text does not say Abraham had no reason to go anywhere because of the offer.
The cookie comparison does not work: leaving cookies on a cooling rack is normal, so it does not match walking away from an offer.
The text does not say Ephron answered right away or spoke fast.
Saying Abraham wanted to settle it properly assigns him a motive the text does not give.
The trees within this field's boundaries were deeded to Abraham. The passage does not say Ephron kept no trees anywhere.
